result.detail: The only assumption is that rst_n is low in cycle 0. Without it, last starts arbitrary and could be 3, a value the spec does not define. The spec says grant is combinational, so the grant properties are sampled on the clock edge, and every reachable post-reset state is checked there. RR-BOUND is read as follows: while req[i] stays high and rst_n stays high, requester i is not refused on more than two consecutive edges. A reset or a dropped req clears the counter. If formal.cover fails, check the cover for a full two-cycle wait (f_waitN == 2) first.
